text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Civil servants now have one of the most advanced collective bargaining mechanisms in Zimbabwe, following the publication on Friday of regulations that set up a Public Service Negotiating Council.
- A Mauritian businessman plans to open an office in his country to handle business inquiries on Zimbabwe and to open a showroom for products from the country.
- The Surveyor-General's office has slashed the period required to draw up new title deeds from six months to four weeks.
